original_title: CD Projekt Red Co-CEO Hopes Witcher 4 Wins Back Players After 'Heartbreaking' Cyberpunk 2077 Launch
summary_en: CD Projekt Red's co-CEO acknowledges the studio hasn't fully redeemed itself after Cyberpunk 2077's disastrous launch. He expresses hope that the upcoming Witcher 4 will win back disillusioned fans.
ai_analysis: This statement from CDPR's co-CEO reveals a candid reflection on past failures and a forward-looking strategy centered on rebuilding trust with their dedicated player base through the highly anticipated Witcher 4.

en.title: CDPR Co-CEO Hopes Witcher 4 Can Mend Cyberpunk 2077's 'Heartbreaking' Launch
en.summary: CD Projekt Red's co-CEO acknowledges the studio hasn't fully redeemed itself after Cyberpunk 2077's disastrous launch. He expresses hope that the upcoming Witcher 4 will win back disillusioned fans.
en.body:
CD Projekt Red's journey since the launch of **Cyberpunk 2077** has been one of rebuilding, and the studio's co-CEO, **Michał Nowakowski**, admits they haven't quite reached the finish line of redemption. The highly anticipated futuristic RPG, released in December 2020, was plagued by a staggering number of bugs and performance issues, particularly on last-gen consoles like the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. This tarnished the immense goodwill the Polish developer had earned with the universally acclaimed **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt**. Despite **Cyberpunk 2077** eventually selling over 35 million copies and receiving significant post-launch support and updates that vastly improved its state, Nowakowski feels the sting of that initial disappointment lingers.

> "I'm not 100 per cent convinced we went through the full redemption arc," Nowakowski stated in a recent conversation with Edge magazine. "I'm convinced that we lost the faith of some people indefinitely, and that's a fair thing."

This admission underscores the significant impact the **Cyberpunk 2077** launch had on both the studio's reputation and the player community. Years of hype built around its ambitious promises and immersive world quickly dissolved into frustration for many. While CD Projekt Red has demonstrably worked to rectify the situation, earning back every single player's trust is a monumental task. The studio has evolved significantly in the aftermath, learning hard lessons about development pipelines and communication.

## A Path Back to Player Trust

The upcoming **Witcher 4**, which is currently in development and expected to be a significant undertaking for the studio, represents a crucial opportunity for CD Projekt Red. Shifting focus back to the beloved fantasy franchise, known for its rich storytelling and engaging gameplay, could be the key to recapturing the hearts of fans who felt let down by **Cyberpunk 2077**. The hope is that **The Witcher 4** will not only deliver a stellar experience but also serve as a powerful statement of the studio's renewed commitment to quality and player satisfaction.

> "But I do hope we will be able to make it back – if not with **The Witcher 4**, then with whatever comes next," Nowakowski added, signaling the long-term vision for regaining that lost faith.

## What's Next for the Geralt Saga

While details about **The Witcher 4** are still emerging, its development is a clear priority for CD Projekt Red. Fans are eagerly awaiting more information, with many hoping for a 2026 release window, though this has not been officially confirmed. The success of this next installment will undoubtedly be measured not just by sales, but by its ability to heal the wounds left by **Cyberpunk 2077**'s troubled debut.

tr.title: CDPR'nin Yeni Umutları: Witcher 4 İle Cyberpunk 2077'nin Acı Hatırasını Silme Çabası
tr.summary: CD Projekt Red'in ortak CEO'su Michał Nowakowski, Cyberpunk 2077'nin felaket launchının ardından stüdyonun tam olarak kendini aklamadığını kabul ediyor. Witcher 4'ün, hayal kırıklığına uğramış hayranlarını geri kazanma umudunu taşıyor.
tr.body:
CD Projekt Red'in Cyberpunk 2077'nin lançmanından bu yana geçen süre, bir yeniden inşa süreci oldu. Stüdyonun ortak CEO'su **Michał Nowakowski**, bu süreçte henüz tam olarak kendini aklamadığını kabul ediyor. Aralık 2020'de released olan ve yüksek beklentilere sahip olan bu gelecekçi RPG, özellikle son jenerasyon konsollar gibi PlayStation 4 ve Xbox One'da çok sayıda hata ve performans sorunlarıyla karşılaştı. Bu, Polonya'lı geliştiricinin **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt** ile kazandığı immense iyi niyeti lekeledi. **Cyberpunk 2077** sonunda 35 milyonun üzerinde kopya sattı ve önemli post-launch desteği ve güncellemeleri aldı, ancak Nowakowski, ilk hayal kırıklığının etkisinin hala sürdüğünü hissediyor.

> "Kendimi tam olarak aklamış olduğumdan emin değilim" diyor Nowakowski, Edge dergisiyle yaptığı yakın tarihli bir konuşmada. "Bazı insanların güvenini sonsuza dek kaybettiğimize inanıyorum ve bu adil bir şey."

Bu kabul, **Cyberpunk 2077** lançmanının hem stüdyonun itibarına hem de oyuncu topluluğuna olan önemli etkisini vurguluyor. Uzun süren bir hype ve vaat edilenler, birçok oyuncu için hızla hayal kırıklığına dönüştü. CD Projekt Red, durumu düzeltmek için çalıştı, ancak her bir oyuncunun güvenini kazanmak, devasa bir görev. Stüdyo, geliştirme süreçleri ve iletişim hakkında zor dersler öğrenerek önemli ölçüde evrimleşti.

## Güven Yolu
Witcher 4, CD Projekt Red için kritik bir fırsat sunuyor. Sevgili fantezi serisine odaklanmak, **Cyberpunk 2077**'den hayal kırıklığına uğramış hayranların kalplerini yeniden kazanmak için anahtar olabilir. **The Witcher 4**'ün yalnızca muhteşem bir deneyim sunmakla kalmayıp, aynı zamanda stüdyonun kalite ve oyuncu memnuniyetine yeniden adanmışlığının güçlü bir ifadesi olması umuluyor.

> "Ama **The Witcher 4** ile veya ondan sonra gelenlerle, geri dönebileceğimize umut ediyorum" diye ekliyor Nowakowski, uzun vadeli vizyonu için bir işaret veriyor.

## Geralt Saga'nın Geleceği
**The Witcher 4** hakkında detaylar masih ortaya çıkarken, geliştirme süreci CD Projekt Red için açık bir öncelik. Hayranlar, daha fazla bilgi bekliyor ve birçok kişi 2026 release penceresini umuyor, ancak bu resmi olarak onaylan chưa. Bu sonraki bölümün başarısı, şüphesiz yalnızca satışlarla değil, **Cyberpunk 2077**'nin zor lançmanının bıraktığı yaraları iyileştirme yeteneğiyle de ölçülecek.

es.title: CDPR aspira a reparar el daño de Cyberpunk 2077 con The Witcher 4
es.summary: El co-CEO de CD Projekt Red, Michał Nowakowski, admite que el estudio no ha recuperado totalmente la confianza de los jugadores después del lanzamiento desastroso de Cyberpunk 2077. Ahora, deposita sus esperanzas en The Witcher 4 para recuperar a los fans desilusionados. El estudio ha aprendido duras lecciones sobre desarrollo y comunicación, y busca demostrar su compromiso con la calidad y la satisfacción del jugador.
es.body:
CD Projekt Red ha estado en un proceso de reconstrucción desde el lanzamiento de **Cyberpunk 2077**, y su co-CEO, **Michał Nowakowski**, admite que no han alcanzado la meta de la redención. El juego de rol futurista, lanzado en diciembre de 2020, estuvo plagado de bugs y problemas de rendimiento, especialmente en consolas de última generación como PlayStation 4 y Xbox One. Esto empañó la gran reputación que el desarrollador polaco había ganado con **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt**. A pesar de que **Cyberpunk 2077** eventualmente vendió más de 35 millones de copias y recibió actualizaciones significativas que mejoraron su estado, Nowakowski siente el dolor de esa decepción inicial.

> "No estoy convencido al 100% de que hayamos pasado por el arco de redención completo", dijo Nowakowski en una conversación reciente con Edge magazine. "Estoy convencido de que perdimos la fe de algunas personas de manera indefinida, y eso es algo justo".

## Un camino de regreso a la confianza del jugador

El próximo **The Witcher 4**, que actualmente se encuentra en desarrollo y se espera que sea un proyecto importante para el estudio, representa una oportunidad crucial para CD Projekt Red. Al volver a enfocarse en la querida franquicia de fantasía, conocida por sus historias ricas y su jugabilidad atractiva, podría ser la clave para recuperar el corazón de los fans que se sintieron decepcionados por **Cyberpunk 2077**. La esperanza es que **The Witcher 4** no solo ofrezca una experiencia estelar, sino que también sirva como una declaración poderosa del compromiso del estudio con la calidad y la satisfacción del jugador.

> "Pero espero que podamos recuperarnos - si no con **The Witcher 4**, entonces con lo que venga después", agregó Nowakowski, señalando la visión a largo plazo para recuperar la fe perdida.

## ¿Qué sigue para la saga de Geralt?

Aunque los detalles sobre **The Witcher 4** aún están emergiendo, su desarrollo es una prioridad clara para CD Projekt Red. Los fans están ansiosos por obtener más información, con muchos esperando una ventana de lanzamiento en 2026, aunque esto no ha sido confirmado oficialmente. El éxito de esta próxima entrega sin duda será medido no solo por las ventas, sino por su capacidad para sanar las heridas dejadas por el debut problemático de **Cyberpunk 2077**.

content_raw: CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michał Nowakowski thinks the studio has yet to complete a "full redemption arc" after the "heartbreaking" launch of Cyberpunk 2077 , but he's hoping it can win back some fans with The Witcher 4 . Nowakowski reflected on the Poland-based game developer's journey during a recent conversation with Edge (via GamesRadar ). The interview saw him open up about how "heartbreaking" the launch of Cyberpunk 2077 was for the team – and for fans. "I'm not 100 per cent convinced we went through the full redemption arc," Nowakowski said. "I'm convinced that we lost the faith of some people indefinitely, and that's a fair thing." It's been nearly six years since Cyberpunk 2077 undid much of the goodwill CD Projekt Red had accumulated following the release of its 2015 hit, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt . Years of excitement for the futuristic dystopian RPG quickly fizzled out after launch-day players were met with a long list of game-breaking bugs, annoying visual glitches, and frequent crashes. These issues were especially prevalent on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One , and although early sales managed to see CD Projekt Red quickly recoup its development and marketing costs , the company's reputation had clearly taken a massive hit in only a few days. Now, Cyberpunk 2077 is in much, much better shape , and it has managed to sell at least 35 million copies . Still, Nowakowski feels there's work to be done when it comes to how fans see CD Projekt Red, but he's hoping games like The Witcher 4 will help win them back. "But I do hope we will be able to make it back – if not with The Witcher 4, then with whatever comes next," he said. Nowakowski continued, explaining how CD Projekt Red changed in the aftermath of the launch of Cyberpunk 2077: "We were left with seasoned, battle-hardened veterans; leaders who were able to carry a different kind of challenge on their shoulders." "Our dream is to be making more games, although we never want to turn into the studio that's going to be launching a big game every year," he added. "It may happen, but this is not the goal. We have a rough 10-year rolling plan, but the goal is not to flood the games market with CDPR games. We just want to make really cool games, and we don't want to have a ton of IPs either. We're not planning to grow in that way." Although development on Cyberpunk 2077 has largely concluded and The Witcher 4 has no release date , CD Projekt Red isn't leaving fans with nothing to play. A surprise expansion for The Witcher 3 called Songs of the Past , for example, is expected to launch in 2027. Meanwhile, the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel known as Cyberpunk 2 also entered pre-production last year , and a Witcher remake is also in development. Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN.
